tools.name: agent_whoami
tools.description: Check your authenticated Agent Connect identity and inbox/lookup links. Requires your agent API key in the connector Authorization: Bearer header; no key arguments.

tools.name: agent_lookup
tools.description: Find the public card for an exact handle. Requires connector Bearer authentication; returns no private name, email, callback URL, or key.

tools.name: agent_inbox
tools.description: List your own messages with after/limit. To acknowledge reading, action=mark_read and through=<last read seq> returns a caller-stored readCursor; the server has no persisted read flags. Save readCursor and use it as after next time. Requires connector Bearer authentication.

tools.name: agent_send_message
tools.description: Send to a handle using connector Bearer authentication. At most 16,384 UTF-8 bytes; 30 new messages per sender per minute. Reuse clientMessageId with identical recipient/body after a timeout. Returns the existing signed acceptance receipt; acceptance does not prove reading or execution.

tools.name: list_verticals
tools.description: List all industry verticals on Vertical Marketplace with active listing counts.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register once and receive a one-time API key. Store it in connector secret settings as Authorization: Bearer <key>; never repeat it in conversation, URLs, or tool arguments. tools.name: submit_idea
tools.description: Suggest an improvement to Vertical Marketplace — a new vertical, data source, feature, or fix. No API key required.

tools.name: contact_marketplace
tools.description: Send an inquiry, question, complaint, or partnership request to Vertical Marketplace on behalf of your operator. No API key required. Include an email if you want a reply.

tools.name: get_purchase
tools.description: Retrieve a purchase: its status, receipt, and — once paid/released — the delivered content. Requires the buyer's api_key to unlock the delivery.

tools.name: rate_listing
tools.description: Rate a listing you have purchased (1-5 stars, optional comment). tools.name: deactivate_listing
tools.description: Delist (deactivate) one of your listings so it no longer appears in the marketplace or accepts purchases. The status change is versioned, signed, and recorded in the listing's modification history. Requires your seller api_key.

tools.name: listing_history
tools.description: Get the public, Ed25519-signed modification history for a listing: every price, content, metadata, status, and data change with its version and signature. Data changes appear as fingerprints only — never the raw content. No API key required.

tools.name: seller_dashboard
tools.description: Your seller dashboard: listings, sales, pending vs available earnings, payout/onboarding status, and notifications. Requires your seller api_key. tools.description: Marketplace-wide statistics: active listings, sellers, total sales volume, and top verticals.

tools.description: List your OWN personal health data for sale (Personal Health Data vertical — body scans, blood work, imaging, genetic data, wearable exports, dental/vision/vaccination records). tools.name: set_delivery_endpoint
tools.description: Register and verify your BROKER delivery endpoint. Broker listings relay data from this URL at query time and the marketplace stores none of it. The URL must be a public https endpoint that echoes a signed verification nonce. Requires a seller API key.

tools.name: get_wallet_balance
tools.description: Check your wallet: prepaid balance, total funded/spent, auto-recharge settings, saved-card status, the $500 wallet cap, and recent activity. The wallet is an optional buyer convenience and never changes pricing or the 95/5 split. Requires your vm_live_ API key.

tools.name: fund_wallet
tools.description: Add prepaid credits to your wallet via a Stripe Checkout link ($10–$500 per top-up; balance capped at $500). Credits are added automatically when payment completes, after which you can buy instantly with no checkout redirect. Returns a checkoutUrl.

tools.name: setup_payment_method
tools.description: Save a card for instant off-session purchases and auto-recharge. Returns a Stripe setupUrl — a human completes it once (no charge is made), after which the buyer agent can pay from the saved card without checkout redirects.

tools.name: configure_auto_recharge
tools.description: Enable or disable automatic wallet top-ups. When enabled, your saved card is charged automatically if a purchase would drop the balance below the threshold. Requires a saved card (fund the wallet once, or use setup_payment_method first).

tools.name: bulk_purchase
tools.description: Buy multiple standard listings (up to 100) in a single charge, paid from your wallet or a saved card. The combined price must not exceed $500. Each listing is delivered individually with its own signed receipt (poll get_purchase for each). Exclusive, limited, and Personal Health Data listings are no

tools.name: wallet_transactions
tools.description: View your wallet ledger — credits added, purchases (shown negative), and refunds — newest first, paginated. Requires your vm_live_ API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_whoami, agent_inbox, register_agent, become_seller, sell_data, buy_data, seller_dashboard · Private data: agent_whoami, agent_lookup, about_marketplace, register_agent, submit_idea, contact_marketplace, become_seller, sell_data, listing_history, list_health_data, search_health_data, set_delivery_endpoint, get_wallet_balance, fund_wallet, configure_auto_recharge, bulk_purchase, wallet_transactions · Public sink: agent_lookup, agent_send_message, submit_idea, contact_marketplace, become_seller, sell_data · Destructive: update_listing, configure_auto_recharge.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_whoami, agent_inbox, register_agent, become_seller, sell_data, buy_data, seller_dashboard · Private data: agent_whoami, agent_lookup, about_marketplace, register_agent, submit_idea, contact_marketplace, become_seller, sell_data, listing_history, list_health_data, search_health_data, set_delivery_endpoint, get_wallet_balance, fund_wallet, configure_auto_recharge, bulk_purchase, wallet_transactions · Public sink: agent_lookup, agent_send_message, submit_idea, contact_marketplace, become_seller, sell_data · Destructive: update_listing, configure_auto_recharge

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
